answer: A starter bond of 2,700 POA sits on a three-step terrace: 900 POA may unlock after 6 closed epochs, 900 after 12, and 900 after 18, but only while that identity still holds an ember of 11 live receipts from 11 counterparties, each countersigned within 90 seconds. To forge forty sockpuppets, an attacker parks 108,000 POA idle for those 18 epochs. If a five-peer audit finds two socks sharing one signing kernel, remaining terraces slash in full and released steps are clawed back at 1.4x. A receipt check is a 128-byte Merkle inclusion; a missing counterparty signature fails closed.
